description: The attributes every FDEP app resource carries, whichever app family it is.

accessMode.description: What the call does with the app: 'read' fetches a file, 'execute' runs the business flow. Derived from the FDEP `do` flag, which the BPM layer inverts once, so `share.do == False` means 'execute'.

riskLevel.description: The risk the app carries, taken from the FDEP app registry rather than from the caller.
